big: Meena sells her flat and wants to send ₹80 lakh to her bank in Singapore. Her bank asks for a chartered accountant's certificate and a tax declaration first. Without them, nothing moves.

lines: Why is sending my own money abroad so hard?
It is not hard, but it follows rules. FEMA governs cross-border flows. For NRO funds there is a yearly limit. For many payments, you need Forms 15CA and 15CB before the bank sends.
